scope.research_boundary: Use one read-only Luna evidence researcher; root is sole writer. Before any query, inspect the exact candidate, all linked source and attempt records, campaign history, and exact query/URL history. This scope authorizes one new B169 dated web-attempt record per field with a formal campaign extension (max_new_attempts=1, allowed_channels=[web], extending that field's previous_attempt_id). Run at most one distinct current exact-model web query per target. Open at most one genuinely new product/seller page per target, only after verifying the complete URL is absent by exact-literal search across repository data and docs; do not reopen any recorded URL. Preserve all prior attempts and campaign history. Search result snippets can discover a lead but cannot substantiate a price. If there is no qualifying public amount, leave price and candidate data unchanged and set the new attempt to blocked with the exact-model reason and relevant source IDs.
price_rules: A price-missing field may be filled only with a dated public manufacturer or seller amount attributable to the exact frameset or exact Crux Comp GRX model; record currency, price type, seller, observation date, and conditions. A quote-only form, search snippet, family-level amount, or ambiguous option does not qualify.
A foreign-currency exact-model asking price may be stored only as a clearly typed reference with its exchange-rate provenance; do not describe it as mainland observed or a transaction price.

For Specialized Crux, preserve model-year and GRX build exactness. Exclude other Crux trims, foreign-market list prices, stale offers, and MSRP where the candidate specifically requires a public dated amount.
excluded: No seller contact, login, CAPTCHA, quote request, cart, purchase, or hidden checkout probing.
No image changes, unrelated candidate or catalog changes, source reuse beyond these five price fields, or external delivery.
The Luna agent must not edit files; root alone integrates qualifying results and updates attempts.
